name: taskplane
description: Turn software goals into clear plans, working code and reviews backed by evidence with Claude or Codex.

interface.longDescription: Taskplane coordinates software delivery from requirements through verification and review. Keep seven separate phase approvals, scoped ownership and actual results connected across Claude and Codex. Use a full delivery, standalone design or code review, or a reusable workflow.
capabilities: Turn an idea into clear requirements and acceptance criteria
Design changes with their dependencies and trade-offs in view
Plan and build features against the agreed outcome
Review code and track findings through verified repairs
Follow progress, verification and available usage in one dashboard
defaultPrompt: taskplane design safe order cancellation before we build it
taskplane build CSV export for the monthly report
taskplane review this branch against main; do not change code
